shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,300p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,110p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,100p' src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts && node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify({eslint:p.scripts.eslint,'spec:names':p.scripts['spec:names'],format:p.scripts.format},null,2))\" && rg -n \"repoint-spec-anchors|reanchor\" package.json scripts .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '50,150p'; nl -ba src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts | sed -n '10,30p'; sed -n '1,110p' scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs; git log -3 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts && node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs && npm run eslint && npm run spec:names'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-abandon-on-close/spec.md specs/hal-engine-commit-open-entries/spec.md specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md specs/hal-engine-single-terminal-frame/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-budget/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-executor-throw/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts && npm run eslint && npm run spec:names'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts && git diff -- specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md | sed -n '1,220p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts specs/hal-engine-abandon-on-close/spec.md specs/hal-engine-commit-open-entries/spec.md specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md specs/hal-engine-single-terminal-frame/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-budget/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-executor-throw/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && git commit -m "fix CI lint and spec anchors" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
